extractions.description: The paper investigates the role of pre-training in lifelong learning, specifically with respect to catastrophic forgetting. It finds that generic pre-training implicitly alleviates the effects of catastrophic forgetting when learning multiple tasks sequentially compared to randomly initialized models.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly mentions reducing energy waste by obviating excessive model re-training.
